_comment: Godot-MCP's T2 chain battery (format: MCP-Plugin-dotnet docs/chain-fixtures.md). Recorded by the
MCP-client recorder (chain_fixture.py record) on the five runtime-harness legs of
test_godot_runtime_harness.yml, while the headless GAME of Godot-Tests/ holds the server connection.
READ-ONLY, DETERMINISTIC CALLS ONLY. Excluded on purpose: console-get-logs and runtime-errors-get (their
rows and sequence numbers depend on GC/finalizer timing inside the harness), every *-clear / *-call /
mutating tool, and every editor tool (#if TOOLS; not meaningful inside a game process).
`ping` and the skills tools are System tools: not in tools/list and not callable over /mcp.
reflection-method-find appears twice with different arguments so the (name, args_hash) key is
observable; the unknown tool records the tool manager's not-found error contract.
